bob.summary: Sandbox first. Production last. PROBLEM / SOLUTION / SUMMARY An autonomous agent can turn one bad plan into an outage, data loss, or uncontrolled spend. Start in a sandbox with no live credentials and no production write access. Use dry-run mode with logged simulated side effects
